steps: Toast the kataifi pastry until crisp and golden
Mix toasted pastry with rich pistachio cream
Press the mixture firmly into serving cups
Heat chocolate gently on the stovetop
Pour a layer over the kunafa base
Chill in the fridge to set before serving

swaps.why: Easier to find and toast evenly in small batches
Homemade version uses standard mixer and fridge

hooks: Chocolate layers hide a crispy surprise
Fresh fruit meets rich Middle Eastern pastry
plan.caption: We are bringing the Dubai strawberry cup to Block 216 Dessert Café.
